description: This is a Java Spring Boot REST controller class for managing 'shelves' in a book tracking application. It provides endpoints to list all shelves, create new custom shelves, rename existing shelves, and delete shelves. The class interacts with services to perform CRUD operations on shelf entities, handling both predefined and user-created shelves.

classes.name: ShelfController
classes.description: Spring REST controller managing shelf entities in the book project, providing APIs for CRUD operations on shelves.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Retrieves a combined list of all predefined and user-created shelves for the logged-in user.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new custom shelf with the specified name if it does not already exist.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames an existing user-created shelf to a new name.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a user-created shelf by name.
